human_understanding_delta: The disk constraint does not add an arbitrary next term to a tied low Newton face. Newton's identities give sum_c c^(n-m)=m(n-m)A_m/n, while disk tangency pairs A_m with -conj(A_m)z^(n-m). Their critical-value trace is therefore the strictly negative norm square -m(n-m)|A_m|^2/n. Since the complementary gap q(n-2m) is smallest for the maximal active low mode, that mode breaks every all-zero leading trace at the first available order and selects a lexicographically negative saddle.
